comparison.objective: Pull cable from a channel to a ruler mark without over-pulling; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable extraction, handover and visual length control versus captive setscrew operation, fine rotary adjustment and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Cable end must finish near 30 cm, straight and released, never beyond 35 cm; candidate must produce two compliant impact cycles.
comparison.reason: Both require bounded adjustment, but cable length metering does not test tool-mediated mechanical commissioning or damping behavior.
